item.title: Match Report: Walsall 0-0 Crawley Town
item.description: Walsall picked up another point in their Sky Bet League Two campaign on Tuesday evening as they played out a goalless draw with Crawley Town at the Pallet-Track Bescot Stadium. It was back-to-back 0-0 draws for the Saddlers as they continued to occupy the playoff positions in the table. Mat Sadler made three changes to his side following the goalless draw on Saturday afternoon. item.title: Mat Sadler praises work ethic after home draw with Crawley Town
item.description: Head Coach Mat Sadler was pleased with the work rate of his side on Tuesday evening as Walsall drew 0-0 against Crawley Town at the Pallet-Track Bescot Stadium. In what was back-to-back goalless draws on home soil, Sadler explained how there was still plenty of things to work on alongside the positive aspects of the game. “I thought it was a tough game,” he said. “There was a hell of a lot of hard work that went into the game. item.title: Comley and Richards visit local school to feel Joy of Moving
item.description: Last week, Saddlers players Brandon Comley and Rico Richards visited the children of Old Park Primary School to get involved with their Joy of Moving session. item.title: Annual Gender Pay Gap Report
item.description: We have recently submitted our annual gender pay gap report as required under Government legislation. The data is available online through the Government portal. As we employ more than 250 full and part-time staff at the snapshot date, we must report our ‘Gender Pay Gap’ information as of 5th April 2025. item.title: New date confirmed for trip to Salford City
item.description: Due to Salford City's participation in the fourth round of the Emirates FA Cup, our trip to the Peninsula Stadium will now take place on Tuesday 10th March, kick-off 7.45pm. The fixture was originally scheduled for Saturday 14th February but has been moved as a result of their fixture against Manchester City taking place that day. Tickets for this fixture will go on sale from Monday 16th February, with full details on prices confirmed in due course.

item.title: Alfie Chang returns to WS1 on permanent deal from Birmingham City
item.description: We are delighted to announce the signing of midfielder Alfie Chang who joins us on a permanent deal until the end of the season, following the termination of his contract at Birmingham City.
